tool: gpt-image-2 through tools/buildings/concept.sh, prompt from tools/icons/icons.py
prompt:
Use case: one game icon for Under the Canopy, a Warcraft III: Reforged-like RTS of insect armies on the forest floor. The game shows it small (about 56 to 72 pixels) on its HUD command card, so it must read instantly at that size.
THE ICON FAMILY (every icon in the game follows it): a square, full-bleed, hand-painted stylised 3D illustration in the manner of Warcraft III: Reforged unit and ability icons. ONE subject, big in the frame, with chunky, simple, bold forms, crisp clean edges, glossy materials with clear edge highlights, saturated but controlled colour. Strong value contrast: the subject is clearly brighter and more saturated than its background, and a bright rim light separates its silhouette. Light: a warm key light from the upper left and a cool blue-violet rim light from behind on the right. The background is dark, simple and soft, never scenery: a smoky vignette that falls to near-black in the corners. Keep the bottom-right corner calm and dark (the game draws a hotkey letter there). NO text, letters, numbers, runes, UI, frame, border or bevel (the game draws the frame). No noise, grain, sparkle, specks or tiny clutter; few, large, clear shapes.
ICON TYPE: HERO PORTRAIT. Like a unit portrait but closer and grander: the head and its unique crown shape (horn, helm, halo) fill the upper half, a slightly low heroic angle from the front-left, shoulders and the top of the signature weapon below. Background: dark smoke with a clear golden glow behind the head, bright enough (mid-value at its centre) that the black crown shape reads sharply against it, falling to near-black in the corners.
NEUTRAL FOREST CREATURES, the wild camps of the forest floor: drawn with the same chunky Warcraft proportions and glossy finish as the armies, in their own natural materials (bark, moss, mushroom caps, water, fur, chitin, paper nests). Corrupted creatures show rot, fungus and magenta-violet spore light; none of them glows green.
REFERENCES: the first image is the creature as it is in the game (keep its design, shape and colours); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
THE SUBJECT: the HOLLOW STAG, a neutral forest creature guarding a camp (melee forest creature. A sacred forest guardian and its bark-and-willow retinue), exactly as in the first reference: its head, face and most recognisable feature large in the frame.
